caption:
Goal-Holding Agents Under Budget Guards — 36/5,400 pre-fix vs. 0/10,800 post-fix overspends · tight-budget gain did not replicate (CPU counter, reported_j)

Across 30 Sudoku tasks, Run 1 caught a pre-fix boundary bug: 36 / 5,400 episodes overspent (R-F2). Moving comparison + receipt logging inside the guard cut overspends to 0 / 10,800 (0 / 5,400 per half).

• Provenance: Signed Provenance · Self-Checked (not externally peer-reviewed; studio voice is_aigc=true)
• Telemetry: reported_j (macOS Darwin ri_energy_nj L3 & Linux RAPL L2 on-chip counters; measured_j = null (no wall meter).)

• Paper: https://research.openie.dev/papers/agency/
